messages:
alex: Starting driver rollout h100: 55.2 -> 56.0 in eu-west2 (canary nodes first). Observed NCCL bcast slowdown and GPU mem-throttling on hopper-sm90 pools. Pausing rollout. Anyone seeing similar? :thinking:

ops-bot: Deploy job #deploy-324 started at 2026-03-18T09:01:40Z

maya: Seen. Canary hopper-sm90-01 shows 20-30% increase in bcast time, tail latency spikes ~200ms. Kernel logs show repeated `sm90_l2_evict` warnings.

jin: Can you paste the `dmesg` snippet and `nvidia-smi topo -m`? Also which NCCL version?

alex: NCCL 2.18.3, CUDA 12.3. dmesg:
```
[  123.456] nv_peer_mem: loading...
[  124.001] nvidia: sm90: L2 eviction stall detected
[  124.120] UVM: GPU memory throttled for context 0x7f...
```

alex: `nvidia-smi topo -m` (canary):
```
        GPU0    GPU1    CPU Affinity
GPU0     X     NVLINK  0-11
GPU1   NVLINK    X     12-23
```

ryan: Checked host NIC (mlx5) errors: RX drops on eth0 over the same time range, counters up ~0.6%. Could be congestion or firmware mismatch after driver change.

maya: Also seeing increased retries in NCCL logs: `transport/gdr_ib_send` timeouts.

jin: Quick mitigation: revert to driver 55.2 on the affected pool? Or set NCCL_P2P_DISABLE=1 for canaries to isolate RDMA path.

alex: Reverted canary group to 55.2, traffic bumped back to normal for those nodes. But ~15% of hopper pool still on 56.0 in other AZs and shows intermittent stalls.

ryan: Propose rolling NIC FW downgrade on a small subset before continuing driver rollout. Need SRE approval for maintenance windows — will affect capacity.

maya: For immediate safety, can we adjust autoscaler to avoid scheduling large multi-GPU jobs on mixed-driver nodes? Throttling happens on cross-driver runs.

jin: Also adding `NCCL_ASYNC_ERROR_HANDLING=1` to test if we get faster failure + fallback.

sre-bot: Incident P0 created: INCIDENT-20260318-01 - Hopper NCCL bcast regression after driver 56.0 rollout (eu-west2). Paging on-call.

alex: Tagging @oncall-sre @infra-leads — we'll need to coordinate cross-AZ rollbacks if FW change required. Cost hit if we remove capacity for maintenance (alerting finance).

ryan: Noted cost hit. If we hold rollout, we should estimate lost throughput -> potential 12% capacity reduction on peak workloads.

maya: Logs attached: internal gist link (private) — contains NCCL traces and dmesg. :link: 

alex: Next steps: 1) pause rollout globally, 2) revert remaining canaries where timeouts present, 3) run NIC FW compatibility test on isolated rack, 4) follow up with NV driver team. Anyone object?

jin: +1

ryan: +1

ops-bot: Deploy job #deploy-324 canceled at 2026-03-18T09:05:21Z by alex

alex: I'll open a tracking ticket with steps and attach perf graphs. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
